name: Ship.com
summary: Shipping software for online sellers: UPS and USPS labels at discounted rates, order tracking emails, marketing emails and a rewards program, with an AI assistant that prepares labels.
best_for: small online sellers who ship US parcels with UPS or USPS and want one tool for labels, tracking emails and basic marketing emails, and who ship enough to make a cap on shipments matter
skip_if: you ship mostly outside the US, you need carriers other than UPS and USPS, or you want a product we have tested ourselves instead of one read from its public pages
honest_knock: Starter is capped at 10 shipments a month and Growth at 100. Postage is billed on top of every plan, the page shows no postage rates, and it names only UPS and USPS. The 30-day refund promise is limited to first-time customers with active order history.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · Starter $4.99 a month (monthly billing only, up to 10 shipments a month)
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-12 on ship.com/pricing, US dollars) Ship.com sells four plans, and you pay postage on top of every one. Starter costs $4.99 a month, is sold monthly only and covers up to 10 shipments a month, discounted rates, email support and one platform integration. Growth costs $19.99 a month, or $14 a month on the yearly toggle, and covers up to 100 shipments a month, heavily discounted rates, priority email support, up to 1,000 marketing emails a month, batch shipping and printing and carrier pickup requests. Executive costs $29.99 a month, or $22 a month on the yearly toggle, and covers unlimited shipments, rates the page says are up to 89% off retail, live chat and phone support, up to 25,000 marketing emails a month, up to 3 platform integrations, a customer rewards program and business reporting. Enterprise has no listed price and adds a dedicated shipping account manager and API or custom integration work. The page offers a free 30-day trial of Executive with no credit card and says you pay only postage during it; Starter and Growth show a free trial of 2 shipments, also postage only. The page promises a refund of subscription fees if you are not satisfied after 30 days, for first-time customers with active order history. We did not open the sign-up flow, so we do not know the tax added, what happens to your card after the trial or how postage is billed.

schema_offer.description: Starter, Starter $4.99 a month (monthly billing only, up to 10 shipments a month); Growth $19.99 a month or $14 a month billed yearly (up to 100 shipments); Executive $29.99 a month or $22 a month billed yearly (unlimited shipments); Enterprise by quote; postage is paid on top of every plan.
